description: How big a TmAgentBadge renders. The size scales the avatar circle and the text together, so a lane header and a fan-out tile pick the density their surface needs without either of them hard-coding a pixel size. An unknown value renders the default (Md) density.

members.name: Sm
members.description: Compact — the density of a table row or a graph node label (20 px avatar).

members.name: Md
members.description: The default — a lane header, a card title (24 px avatar).

members.name: Lg
members.description: Prominent — the agent in focus, a detail header (32 px avatar).
